title: AssignmentAttemptJourneyCall
description: Assignment journey call used defining calls in a journey

quayId.description: Id of the quay (NSR:Quay:xxx) to be serviced or the depot (RUT/NBU)

arrivalDateTime.description: Required for all calls except the first call to be serviced. DateTime as specified in the [ADT documentation.](https://adt.transhub.io)

departureDateTime.description: Required for all calls except the last call to be serviced. DateTime as specified in the [ADT documentation.](https://adt.transhub.io)
